summary: with returns a new array replacing one indexed item while keeping the receiver unchanged.
documentation: with returns a new array replacing one indexed item while keeping the receiver unchanged. Negative indices count from the end. An index outside the array throws RangeError instead of extending it.
inputs: A valid positive or negative index and replacement value.
returns: A shallow copy with one replacement.
caution: This requires a modern engine. Nested objects remain shared; copying does not deeply clone them.
scenarios: Preview an edited itinerary without committing its source order.
Replace a quantity in an immutable cart snapshot.
Compare a revised staffing slot with the original schedule.
title: Preview a slot replacement
problem: Input has items (a nonempty array), index (an integer valid for that array, possibly negative), and replacement. Return {original: unchangedItems, updated: copiedItemsWithReplacement}. Keep all other elements intact.
goal: Use Array.with() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use with on items, or copy before assigning.
